title: sync's gate runs the tests of the code a change touches, cloud-session scenarios included
goal: A change to kbgit.py sync makes sync's own gate run the tests that exercise it, TestCloudInGit included, so a regression like BG-7kug25eh (lane routing broke the cloud-session distill, caught only by a later full run in SP-v5xagbyv) cannot pass the gate; check first whether _tools/testmap.py's selection already covers it and add only what is missing
